a.lede: Project Leonida, a recompilation project aiming to bring the console version of GTA 6 to the PC, has shut down with its Discord and GitHub servers offline, and its creator is now banned from the former until 2028.
a.title: Rockstar nukes 15-year-old’s GTA 6 recompilation project, Discord and GitHub servers taken down

b.lede: Despite Take-Two's effort to shut down projects to port GTA VI, multiple projects have reported progress and could now run the game at lower frame rates on PCs.
b.title: Take-Two wipes out 3,007 GTA 6 PC port repos from GitHub in massive DMCA crackdown
